coordinateSystem.horizontal: WGS84 / EPSG:4326 source; runtime converts to local ENU
coordinateSystem.rule: All eras inherit one terrain mesh and one local coordinate transform. Historical layers never move the land to fit a reconstruction.

areaOfInterest.reason: Covers western Old City/Jaffa approach, southeastern ridge/Gihon landscape, Temple Mount/Haram, Kidron Valley and Mount of Olives in one terrain authority.

terrainSource.accessNote: GLO-30 currently requires Copernicus CCM registration; GLO-90 remains the default open service instance.
terrainSource.rule: Do not silently substitute proprietary terrain or Google 3D tiles.

modernVectorContext.use: present-day roads/building/wall reference only; never evidence for ancient geometry

geographicAnchors.label: 東南山脊 / ancient settlement spine

acceptance: Gihon/southeastern ridge, Temple Mount, Kidron and Mount of Olives must read as one continuous relief system.
Jesus Entry route must descend from Mount of Olives toward Kidron and rise toward Jerusalem rather than float on a flat plan.
Jaffa Gate is an Ottoman/present spatial anchor; its geographic camera may persist backward while the gate object itself must disappear before its era.
DEM provenance and attribution remain visible in project metadata.
